BILL NUMBER:  S4613

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the education law, in relation to including Aviation
High School as a special high school in New York city


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
This bill adds Aviation High School to the list of special New York
City high schools.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Adds Aviation High School to the existing list of NYC high schools
which require admission by "solely and exclusively taking a
competitive, objective and scholastic achievement examination".
Aviation will be included in a list that currently includes Bronx High
School of Science, Stuyvesant High School and Brooklyn High School.

 EFFECTS OF PRESENT LAW WHICH THIS BILL WOULD ALTER :
It amends section one paragraphs (a) and (b) of subdivision twelve of
section twenty-five hundred ninety-g of the Education Law, by adding
Aviation High School to the list of special high schools.

 JUSTIFICATION :
Aviation High School is the only public school in NYS to offer the
course leading to F.A.A. certification in air frame/power plant
aviation mechanics and F.C.C. certification in avionics (aviation
electricity). These technical programs lead to jobs with significant
beginning salaries. To replace the screened admission process with an
objective examination will promote fuller participation by all NYC
students of all backgrounds. Given Aviation's unique technical
professional opportunities, it should be in the same category as
Brooklyn Technical High School and NYC's other specialized high
schools.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
This bill has no fiscal impact locally.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
1989-08--Referred to Education Committee

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.

summary: Designates Aviation High School in New York City as a special New York city high school which requires admission based by "solely and exclusively taking a competitive, objective and scholastic achievement examination".
title: Designates Aviation High School in New York city a special high school
